lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is a Telluride Medical Center special meeting where the board takes up a proposal to engage Jensen Partners for due diligence with CommonSpirit Health — one of the country's largest hospital systems — a signal that a formal partnership or affiliation could be moving forward. Alongside that, Ouray City Council holds a public hearing on its 2027 budget and votes on second reading of two ordinances setting utility rates and adding a new light-industrial rate category, while Telluride's Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered lawn equipment in town limits by 2028–2030. Halloween weekend kicks things off with the parade, Young Frankenstein at the high school, and a full slate of community events before the week turns to Mountainfilm for Locals.
